names.summary: A 103-byte housekeeping beacon with a unix timestamp at offset 32, a boot-relative uptime clock at 93 and several counters. It has a block of solar-array style channels (offsets 57-67) that drop to near zero in shadow, a battery-related group, and four bus channels at 79-85 that move together and are higher in shadow. Every frame has an eclipse in the previous 80 minutes, so the lagged correlations are meaningful.

fields.name: battery_temperature
fields.rationale: Signed byte of -13..37, warmer in shadow with a narrow range and rising with sunlight history. This matches a heated internal or battery temperature, though the correlation is weak. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_voltage
fields.rationale: u2 of 8535-8833 is a narrow band (spread 0.03) at the two-cell Li-ion range 6000-8400 mV, slightly above it. It is higher in sun (rho 0.55) and the hint is battery. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_temperature
fields.rationale: u1 in 18..22, rising in sun (trend 0.64) and falling in shadow (-0.28), with rho 0.87. This is a slow internal thermal response; it could also be a state of charge on a coarse scale, but the range is too narrow for that. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: unix_timestamp
fields.rationale: u4 that increments at 1 s/s with no resets and an epoch guess of unix (values around 1.795e9). [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: packet_sequence_counter
fields.rationale: u3 that mostly increases with 2 resets (the last about 1.9 days before the end), so it may wrap or the unit may reboot. The median step within a pass of 30 matches the frame cadence. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: unknown_slow_analog
fields.rationale: u2 in 7612..8028 with a weak orbit r2 of 0.26 and a mild sun correlation. The daily low drifts downward, but the evidence is too thin to name it. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_1
fields.rationale: Near zero in shadow, plateau around 1300-5000 in sun, strongly sun-correlated (rho 0.88). [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_2
fields.rationale: Near zero in shadow, about 4400-5300 in sun, power_class_hint is solar, and it moves with offset 61. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_3
fields.rationale: Near zero in shadow and about 4300 in sun, and it moves with offset 59. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_4
fields.rationale: Near zero in shadow, about 1000-1200 in sun, rho 0.87, hint is solar. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_5
fields.rationale: Zero in shadow and up to 1233 in sun, but it decays with time since sunrise and depends on beta. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_6
fields.rationale: Zero in shadow, up to 1286 in sun, rho 0.90, decaying after sunrise. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_current
fields.rationale: Signed s2 that is positive in sun (about +100) and negative in shadow (about -40 to -170), consistent with charging and discharging. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: load_current_1
fields.rationale: Signed, smooth and higher in shadow (825 vs 422), and moves with offsets 81, 83 and 85. The hint is bus/load, possibly heater or payload channels. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: load_current_2
fields.rationale: Same behaviour as offset 79 and moves with the group. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: load_current_3
fields.rationale: Same behaviour as offset 79 and moves with the group. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: load_current_4
fields.rationale: Same behaviour as offset 79 and moves with the group. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: uptime_seconds
fields.rationale: u3 that increments at about 1 s/s with 1 reset about 6.9 days before the end. It is an uptime counter that restarted, or a wrapping value. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: clock_like_counter
fields.rationale: u4 that only increases, at 0.0039 per second, and is flat across sun and shadow. It moves with the timestamp but advances in rare large jumps; the values are near 2^32, so it may be a different time base. [2/3 samples agree]

names.health: The uptime clock at offset 93 reset once about 6.9 days before the end and the sequence counter at 36 reset twice, so there was at least one reboot in the 11.4-day window. Battery voltage tracks sunlight within a narrow band, with no clear ageing trend in 11 days. Temperatures are modest, so the battery and thermal state look nominal, but the evidence is limited.
